description: Roman roadside settlement north east of Caerleon. Thought to have originated in the later 1st - early 2nd CE, and thought to have been abandoned by the early/mid 4th CE. A masonry building has been identified by geophysics which has been interpreted as a romano-celtic temple on morphological grounds.
